      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: coverage-unit-${{matrix.shard}}
          path: coverage/unit/coverage-unit-${{matrix.shard}}.json

  test-webpack:
    name: Webpack tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup environment
        uses: metamask/github-tools/.github/actions/setup-environment@main

      - name: test:unit:webpack:coverage
        run: yarn test:unit:webpack:coverage

      - name: Rename coverage
        run: mv coverage/webpack/coverage-final.json coverage/webpack/coverage-webpack.json

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: coverage-webpack
          path: coverage/webpack/coverage-webpack.json

  test-integration:
    name: Integration tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup environment
        uses: metamask/github-tools/.github/actions/setup-environment@main

      - name: test:integration:coverage
        run: yarn test:integration:coverage

      - name: Rename coverage
        run: mv coverage/integration/coverage-final.json coverage/integration/coverage-integration.json

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: coverage-integration
          path: coverage/integration/coverage-integration.json

  report-coverage:
    name: Report coverage
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs:
      - test-unit
      - test-webpack
      - test-integration
    outputs:
      current-coverage: ${{ steps.get-current-coverage.outputs.CURRENT_COVERAGE }}
      stored-coverage: ${{ steps.get-stored-coverage.outputs.STORED_COVERAGE }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup environment
        uses: metamask/github-tools/.github/actions/setup-environment@main

      - name: Download artifacts
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          path: coverage
          merge-multiple: true

        run: yarn nyc merge coverage .nyc_output/coverage-final.json && yarn nyc report --reporter lcov

        with:

          path: coverage/lcov.info

      - name: Get current coverage

          stored_coverage=$(jq ".coverage" coverage.json)
          echo "The stored coverage is $stored_coverage%."
          echo 'STORED_COVERAGE='"$stored_coverage" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Validate test coverage
        env:
          CURRENT_COVERAGE: ${{ steps.get-current-coverage.outputs.CURRENT_COVERAGE }}
          STORED_COVERAGE: ${{ steps.get-stored-coverage.outputs.STORED_COVERAGE }}
        run: |
          if (( $(echo "$CURRENT_COVERAGE < $STORED_COVERAGE" | bc -l) )); then
            echo "::error::Quality gate failed for test coverage. Current coverage is $CURRENT_COVERAGE%, please increase coverage to at least $STORED_COVERAGE%."
            exit 1
          else
            echo "The current coverage is $CURRENT_COVERAGE%, stored coverage is $STORED_COVERAGE%. Quality gate passed."
          fi

name: Build beta

on:
  workflow_call:

jobs:
  build-beta:
    name: Build beta
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          # By default, the checkout action checks out the last merge commit for pull requests.
          # Source: https://docs.github.com/en/actions/writing-workflows/choosing-when-your-workflow-runs/events-that-trigger-workflows#pull_request
          # However, we need the head commit (the latest commit pushed to the source branch)
          # because in the workflow, we would like to parse the latest commit message.
          # Specifying `ref` ensures that the head commit is checked out directly.
          # For a `pull_request` event, the head commit hash is `github.event.pull_request.head.sha`.
          # For a `push` event, the head commit hash is `github.sha`.
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}

      - name: Needs beta build
        # For a `pull_request` event, the branch is `github.head_ref``.
        # For a `push` event, the branch is `github.ref_name`.
        if: ${{ (github.head_ref || github.ref_name) != 'master' }}
        id: needs-beta-build
        env:
          BRANCH: ${{ github.head_ref || github.ref_name }}
        run: |
          version="${BRANCH/Version-v/}"
          commit_message=$(git show -s --format=%s HEAD)
          beta_version_regex="Version v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+-beta\.[0-9]+"

          if [[ "$commit_message" =~ $beta_version_regex ]]; then
              printf '%s\n' "Creating a build for $version with $commit_message"
              echo "NEEDS_BETA_BUILD=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
              printf '%s\n' 'Commit message does not match commit message for beta pattern; skipping beta build'
              echo "NEEDS_BETA_BUILD=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

      - name: Setup environment
        if: ${{ steps.needs-beta-build.outputs.NEEDS_BETA_BUILD == 'true' }}
        uses: metamask/github-tools/.github/actions/setup-environment@main

      - name: Run beta build
        if: ${{ steps.needs-beta-build.outputs.NEEDS_BETA_BUILD == 'true' }}
        env:
          INFURA_PROJECT_ID: 00000000000
          INFURA_BETA_PROJECT_ID: 00000000000
          SEGMENT_BETA_WRITE_KEY: 00000000000
          ENABLE_MV3: true
        run: |
          yarn build --build-type beta --platform='chrome' dist
          yarn build --build-type beta --platform='chrome' prod

      - name: Validate source maps
        if: ${{ steps.needs-beta-build.outputs.NEEDS_BETA_BUILD == 'true' }}
        run: yarn validate-source-maps

      - name: Upload 'dist-beta' to S3
        if: ${{ steps.needs-beta-build.outputs.NEEDS_BETA_BUILD == 'true' }}
        uses: metamask/github-tools/.github/actions/upload-s3@1233659b3850eb84824d7375e2e0c58eb237701d

          s3-bucket: ${{ vars.AWS_S3_BUCKET }}/${{ github.event.repository.name }}/${{ github.run_id }}/dist-beta
          path: dist

name: Run tests

on:
  workflow_call:
    outputs:
      current-coverage:
        description: Current coverage
        value: ${{ jobs.report-coverage.outputs.current-coverage }}
      stored-coverage:
        description: Stored coverage
        value: ${{ jobs.report-coverage.outputs.stored-coverage }}

jobs:
  test-unit:
    name: Unit tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        shard: [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6]
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup environment
        uses: metamask/github-tools/.github/actions/setup-environment@main

      - name: test:unit:coverage
        run: yarn test:unit:coverage --shard=${{ matrix.shard }}/${{ strategy.job-total }}

      - name: Rename coverage
        run: mv coverage/unit/coverage-final.json coverage/unit/coverage-unit-${{matrix.shard}}.json

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: coverage-unit-${{matrix.shard}}
          path: coverage/unit/coverage-unit-${{matrix.shard}}.json

  test-webpack:
    name: Webpack tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup environment
        uses: metamask/github-tools/.github/actions/setup-environment@main

      - name: test:unit:webpack:coverage
        run: yarn test:unit:webpack:coverage

      - name: Rename coverage
        run: mv coverage/webpack/coverage-final.json coverage/webpack/coverage-webpack.json

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: coverage-webpack
          path: coverage/webpack/coverage-webpack.json

  test-integration:
    name: Integration tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup environment
        uses: metamask/github-tools/.github/actions/setup-environment@main

      - name: test:integration:coverage
        run: yarn test:integration:coverage

      - name: Rename coverage
        run: mv coverage/integration/coverage-final.json coverage/integration/coverage-integration.json

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: coverage-integration
          path: coverage/integration/coverage-integration.json

  report-coverage:
    name: Report coverage
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs:
      - test-unit
      - test-webpack
      - test-integration
    outputs:
      current-coverage: ${{ steps.get-current-coverage.outputs.CURRENT_COVERAGE }}
      stored-coverage: ${{ steps.get-stored-coverage.outputs.STORED_COVERAGE }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup environment
        uses: metamask/github-tools/.github/actions/setup-environment@main

      - name: Download artifacts
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          path: coverage
          merge-multiple: true

      - name: Merge coverage reports
        run: yarn nyc merge coverage .nyc_output/coverage-final.json && yarn nyc report --reporter lcov

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: lcov.info
          path: coverage/lcov.info

      - name: Get current coverage
        id: get-current-coverage
        run: |
          current_coverage=$(yarn nyc report --reporter=text-summary | grep 'Lines' | awk '{gsub(/%/, ""); print int($3)}')
          echo "The current coverage is $current_coverage%."
          echo 'CURRENT_COVERAGE='"$current_coverage" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Get stored coverage
        id: get-stored-coverage
        run: |
          stored_coverage=$(jq ".coverage" coverage.json)
          echo "The stored coverage is $stored_coverage%."
          echo 'STORED_COVERAGE='"$stored_coverage" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Validate test coverage
        env:
          CURRENT_COVERAGE: ${{ steps.get-current-coverage.outputs.CURRENT_COVERAGE }}
          STORED_COVERAGE: ${{ steps.get-stored-coverage.outputs.STORED_COVERAGE }}
        run: |
          if (( $(echo "$CURRENT_COVERAGE < $STORED_COVERAGE" | bc -l) )); then
            echo "::error::Quality gate failed for test coverage. Current coverage is $CURRENT_COVERAGE%, please increase coverage to at least $STORED_COVERAGE%."
            exit 1
          else
            echo "The current coverage is $CURRENT_COVERAGE%, stored coverage is $STORED_COVERAGE%. Quality gate passed."
          fi

name: Build beta

on:
  workflow_call:

jobs:
  build-beta:
    name: Build beta
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          # By default, the checkout action checks out the last merge commit for pull requests.
          # Source: https://docs.github.com/en/actions/writing-workflows/choosing-when-your-workflow-runs/events-that-trigger-workflows#pull_request
          # However, we need the head commit (the latest commit pushed to the source branch)
          # because in the workflow, we would like to parse the latest commit message.
          # Specifying `ref` ensures that the head commit is checked out directly.
          # For a `pull_request` event, the head commit hash is `github.event.pull_request.head.sha`.
          # For a `push` event, the head commit hash is `github.sha`.
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}

      - name: Needs beta build
        # For a `pull_request` event, the branch is `github.head_ref``.
        # For a `push` event, the branch is `github.ref_name`.
        if: ${{ (github.head_ref || github.ref_name) != 'master' }}
        id: needs-beta-build
        env:
          BRANCH: ${{ github.head_ref || github.ref_name }}
        run: |
          version="${BRANCH/Version-v/}"
          commit_message=$(git show -s --format=%s HEAD)
          beta_version_regex="Version v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+-beta\.[0-9]+"

          if [[ "$commit_message" =~ $beta_version_regex ]]; then
              printf '%s\n' "Creating a build for $version with $commit_message"
              echo "NEEDS_BETA_BUILD=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
              printf '%s\n' 'Commit message does not match commit message for beta pattern; skipping beta build'
              echo "NEEDS_BETA_BUILD=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

      - name: Setup environment
        if: ${{ steps.needs-beta-build.outputs.NEEDS_BETA_BUILD == 'true' }}
        uses: metamask/github-tools/.github/actions/setup-environment@main

      - name: Run beta build
        if: ${{ steps.needs-beta-build.outputs.NEEDS_BETA_BUILD == 'true' }}
        env:
          INFURA_PROJECT_ID: 00000000000
          INFURA_BETA_PROJECT_ID: 00000000000
          SEGMENT_BETA_WRITE_KEY: 00000000000
          ENABLE_MV3: true
        run: |

name: Run tests

on:
  workflow_call:
    outputs:
      current-coverage:
        description: Current coverage
        value: ${{ jobs.report-coverage.outputs.current-coverage }}
      stored-coverage:
        description: Stored coverage
        value: ${{ jobs.report-coverage.outputs.stored-coverage }}

jobs:
  test-unit:
    name: Unit tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        shard: [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6]
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup environment
        uses: metamask/github-tools/.github/actions/setup-environment@main

      - name: test:unit:coverage
        run: yarn test:unit:coverage --shard=${{ matrix.shard }}/${{ strategy.job-total }}

      - name: Rename coverage
        run: mv coverage/unit/coverage-final.json coverage/unit/coverage-unit-${{matrix.shard}}.json

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: coverage-unit-${{matrix.shard}}
          path: coverage/unit/coverage-unit-${{matrix.shard}}.json

  test-webpack:
    name: Webpack tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup environment
        uses: metamask/github-tools/.github/actions/setup-environment@main

      - name: test:unit:webpack:coverage
        run: yarn test:unit:webpack:coverage

      - name: Rename coverage
        run: mv coverage/webpack/coverage-final.json coverage/webpack/coverage-webpack.json

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: coverage-webpack
          path: coverage/webpack/coverage-webpack.json

  test-integration:
    name: Integration tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup environment
        uses: metamask/github-tools/.github/actions/setup-environment@main

      - name: test:integration:coverage
        run: yarn test:integration:coverage

      - name: Rename coverage
        run: mv coverage/integration/coverage-final.json coverage/integration/coverage-integration.json

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: coverage-integration
          path: coverage/integration/coverage-integration.json

  report-coverage:
    name: Report coverage
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs:
      - test-unit
      - test-webpack
      - test-integration
    outputs:
      current-coverage: ${{ steps.get-current-coverage.outputs.CURRENT_COVERAGE }}
      stored-coverage: ${{ steps.get-stored-coverage.outputs.STORED_COVERAGE }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup environment
        uses: metamask/github-tools/.github/actions/setup-environment@main

      - name: Download artifacts
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          path: coverage
          merge-multiple: true

      - name: Merge coverage reports
        run: yarn nyc merge coverage .nyc_output/coverage-final.json && yarn nyc report --reporter lcov

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: lcov.info
          path: coverage/lcov.info

      - name: Get current coverage
        id: get-current-coverage
        run: |
          current_coverage=$(yarn nyc report --reporter=text-summary | grep 'Lines' | awk '{gsub(/%/, ""); print int($3)}')
          echo "The current coverage is $current_coverage%."
          echo 'CURRENT_COVERAGE='"$current_coverage" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Get stored coverage
        id: get-stored-coverage
        run: |
          stored_coverage=$(jq ".coverage" coverage.json)
          echo "The stored coverage is $stored_coverage%."
          echo 'STORED_COVERAGE='"$stored_coverage" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Validate test coverage
        env:
          CURRENT_COVERAGE: ${{ steps.get-current-coverage.outputs.CURRENT_COVERAGE }}
          STORED_COVERAGE: ${{ steps.get-stored-coverage.outputs.STORED_COVERAGE }}
        run: |
          if (( $(echo "$CURRENT_COVERAGE < $STORED_COVERAGE" | bc -l) )); then
            echo "::error::Quality gate failed for test coverage. Current coverage is $CURRENT_COVERAGE%, please increase coverage to at least $STORED_COVERAGE%."
            exit 1
          else
            echo "The current coverage is $CURRENT_COVERAGE%, stored coverage is $STORED_COVERAGE%. Quality gate passed."
          fi

name: Build beta

on:
  workflow_call:

jobs:
  build-beta:
    name: Build beta
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          # By default, the checkout action checks out the last merge commit for pull requests.
          # Source: https://docs.github.com/en/actions/writing-workflows/choosing-when-your-workflow-runs/events-that-trigger-workflows#pull_request
          # However, we need the head commit (the latest commit pushed to the source branch)
          # because in the workflow, we would like to parse the latest commit message.
          # Specifying `ref` ensures that the head commit is checked out directly.
          # For a `pull_request` event, the head commit hash is `github.event.pull_request.head.sha`.
          # For a `push` event, the head commit hash is `github.sha`.
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}

      - name: Needs beta build
        # For a `pull_request` event, the branch is `github.head_ref``.
        # For a `push` event, the branch is `github.ref_name`.
        if: ${{ (github.head_ref || github.ref_name) != 'master' }}
        id: needs-beta-build
        env:
          BRANCH: ${{ github.head_ref || github.ref_name }}
        run: |
          version="${BRANCH/Version-v/}"
          commit_message=$(git show -s --format=%s HEAD)
          beta_version_regex="Version v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+-beta\.[0-9]+"

          if [[ "$commit_message" =~ $beta_version_regex ]]; then
              printf '%s\n' "Creating a build for $version with $commit_message"
              echo "NEEDS_BETA_BUILD=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
              printf '%s\n' 'Commit message does not match commit message for beta pattern; skipping beta build'
              echo "NEEDS_BETA_BUILD=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

      - name: Setup environment
        if: ${{ steps.needs-beta-build.outputs.NEEDS_BETA_BUILD == 'true' }}
        uses: metamask/github-tools/.github/actions/setup-environment@main

      - name: Run beta build
        if: ${{ steps.needs-beta-build.outputs.NEEDS_BETA_BUILD == 'true' }}
        env:
          INFURA_PROJECT_ID: 00000000000
          INFURA_BETA_PROJECT_ID: 00000000000
          SEGMENT_BETA_WRITE_KEY: 00000000000
          ENABLE_MV3: true
        run: |
          yarn build --build-type beta --platform='chrome' dist
          yarn build --build-type beta --platform='chrome' prod

      - name: Validate source maps
        if: ${{ steps.needs-beta-build.outputs.NEEDS_BETA_BUILD == 'true' }}
        run: yarn validate-source-maps

      - name: Upload 'dist-beta' to S3
        if: ${{ steps.needs-beta-build.outputs.NEEDS_BETA_BUILD == 'true' }}
        uses: metamask/github-tools/.github/actions/upload-s3@1233659b3850eb84824d7375e2e0c58eb237701d

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:

        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup environment
        uses: metamask/github-tools/.github/actions/setup-environment@main

      - name: test:unit:webpack:coverage
        run: yarn test:unit:webpack:coverage

      - name: Rename coverage
        run: mv coverage/webpack/coverage-final.json coverage/webpack/coverage-webpack.json

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: coverage-webpack
          path: coverage/webpack/coverage-webpack.json

  test-integration:
    name: Integration tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup environment
        uses: metamask/github-tools/.github/actions/setup-environment@main

      - name: test:integration:coverage
        run: yarn test:integration:coverage

      - name: Rename coverage
        run: mv coverage/integration/coverage-final.json coverage/integration/coverage-integration.json

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: coverage-integration
          path: coverage/integration/coverage-integration.json

  report-coverage:
    name: Report coverage
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs:
      - test-unit
      - test-webpack
      - test-integration
    outputs:
      current-coverage: ${{ steps.get-current-coverage.outputs.CURRENT_COVERAGE }}
      stored-coverage: ${{ steps.get-stored-coverage.outputs.STORED_COVERAGE }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup environment
        uses: metamask/github-tools/.github/actions/setup-environment@main

      - name: Download artifacts
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          path: coverage
          merge-multiple: true

      - name: Merge coverage reports
        run: yarn nyc merge coverage .nyc_output/coverage-final.json && yarn nyc report --reporter lcov

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: lcov.info
          path: coverage/lcov.info

      - name: Get current coverage
        id: get-current-coverage
        run: |
          current_coverage=$(yarn nyc report --reporter=text-summary | grep 'Lines' | awk '{gsub(/%/, ""); print int($3)}')
          echo "The current coverage is $current_coverage%."
          echo 'CURRENT_COVERAGE='"$current_coverage" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Get stored coverage
        id: get-stored-coverage
        run: |
          stored_coverage=$(jq ".coverage" coverage.json)
          echo "The stored coverage is $stored_coverage%."
          echo 'STORED_COVERAGE='"$stored_coverage" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Validate test coverage
        env:
          CURRENT_COVERAGE: ${{ steps.get-current-coverage.outputs.CURRENT_COVERAGE }}
          STORED_COVERAGE: ${{ steps.get-stored-coverage.outputs.STORED_COVERAGE }}
        run: |
          if (( $(echo "$CURRENT_COVERAGE < $STORED_COVERAGE" | bc -l) )); then
            echo "::error::Quality gate failed for test coverage. Current coverage is $CURRENT_COVERAGE%, please increase coverage to at least $STORED_COVERAGE%."
            exit 1
          else
            echo "The current coverage is $CURRENT_COVERAGE%, stored coverage is $STORED_COVERAGE%. Quality gate passed."
          fi

name: Build beta

on:
  workflow_call:

jobs:
  build-beta:
    name: Build beta
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          # By default, the checkout action checks out the last merge commit for pull requests.
          # Source: https://docs.github.com/en/actions/writing-workflows/choosing-when-your-workflow-runs/events-that-trigger-workflows#pull_request
          # However, we need the head commit (the latest commit pushed to the source branch)
          # because in the workflow, we would like to parse the latest commit message.
          # Specifying `ref` ensures that the head commit is checked out directly.
          # For a `pull_request` event, the head commit hash is `github.event.pull_request.head.sha`.
          # For a `push` event, the head commit hash is `github.sha`.
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}

      - name: Needs beta build
        # For a `pull_request` event, the branch is `github.head_ref``.
        # For a `push` event, the branch is `github.ref_name`.
        if: ${{ (github.head_ref || github.ref_name) != 'master' }}
        id: needs-beta-build
        env:
          BRANCH: ${{ github.head_ref || github.ref_name }}
        run: |
          version="${BRANCH/Version-v/}"
          commit_message=$(git show -s --format=%s HEAD)
          beta_version_regex="Version v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+-beta\.[0-9]+"

          if [[ "$commit_message" =~ $beta_version_regex ]]; then
              printf '%s\n' "Creating a build for $version with $commit_message"
              echo "NEEDS_BETA_BUILD=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
              printf '%s\n' 'Commit message does not match commit message for beta pattern; skipping beta build'
              echo "NEEDS_BETA_BUILD=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

      - name: Setup environment
        if: ${{ steps.needs-beta-build.outputs.NEEDS_BETA_BUILD == 'true' }}
        uses: metamask/github-tools/.github/actions/setup-environment@main

      - name: Run beta build
        if: ${{ steps.needs-beta-build.outputs.NEEDS_BETA_BUILD == 'true' }}
        env:
          INFURA_PROJECT_ID: 00000000000
          INFURA_BETA_PROJECT_ID: 00000000000
          SEGMENT_BETA_WRITE_KEY: 00000000000
          ENABLE_MV3: true
        run: |
          yarn build --build-type beta --platform='chrome' dist
          yarn build --build-type beta --platform='chrome' prod

      - name: Validate source maps
        if: ${{ steps.needs-beta-build.outputs.NEEDS_BETA_BUILD == 'true' }}
        run: yarn validate-source-maps

      - name: Upload 'dist-beta' to S3
        if: ${{ steps.needs-beta-build.outputs.NEEDS_BETA_BUILD == 'true' }}
        uses: metamask/github-tools/.github/actions/upload-s3@1233659b3850eb84824d7375e2e0c58eb237701d
        with:

          role-to-assume: ${{ vars.AWS_IAM_ROLE }}
          s3-bucket: ${{ vars.AWS_S3_BUCKET }}/${{ github.event.repository.name }}/${{ github.run_id }}/dist-beta
          path: dist

name: Build beta

on:
  workflow_call:

jobs:
  build-beta:
    name: Build beta
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          # By default, the checkout action checks out the last merge commit for pull requests.
          # Source: https://docs.github.com/en/actions/writing-workflows/choosing-when-your-workflow-runs/events-that-trigger-workflows#pull_request
          # However, we need the head commit (the latest commit pushed to the source branch)
          # because in the workflow, we would like to parse the latest commit message.
          # Specifying `ref` ensures that the head commit is checked out directly.
          # For a `pull_request` event, the head commit hash is `github.event.pull_request.head.sha`.
          # For a `push` event, the head commit hash is `github.sha`.
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}

      - name: Needs beta build
        # For a `pull_request` event, the branch is `github.head_ref``.
        # For a `push` event, the branch is `github.ref_name`.
        if: ${{ (github.head_ref || github.ref_name) != 'master' }}
        id: needs-beta-build
        env:
          BRANCH: ${{ github.head_ref || github.ref_name }}
        run: |
          version="${BRANCH/Version-v/}"
          commit_message=$(git show -s --format=%s HEAD)
          beta_version_regex="Version v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+-beta\.[0-9]+"

          if [[ "$commit_message" =~ $beta_version_regex ]]; then
              printf '%s\n' "Creating a build for $version with $commit_message"
              echo "NEEDS_BETA_BUILD=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
              printf '%s\n' 'Commit message does not match commit message for beta pattern; skipping beta build'
              echo "NEEDS_BETA_BUILD=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

      - name: Setup environment
        if: ${{ steps.needs-beta-build.outputs.NEEDS_BETA_BUILD == 'true' }}
        uses: metamask/github-tools/.github/actions/setup-environment@main

      - name: Run beta build
        if: ${{ steps.needs-beta-build.outputs.NEEDS_BETA_BUILD == 'true' }}
        env:
          INFURA_PROJECT_ID: 00000000000
          INFURA_BETA_PROJECT_ID: 00000000000
          SEGMENT_BETA_WRITE_KEY: 00000000000
          ENABLE_MV3: true
        run: |
          yarn build --build-type beta --platform='chrome' dist
          yarn build --build-type beta --platform='chrome' prod

      - name: Validate source maps
        if: ${{ steps.needs-beta-build.outputs.NEEDS_BETA_BUILD == 'true' }}
        run: yarn validate-source-maps

      - name: Upload 'dist-beta' to S3

name: Build beta

on:
  workflow_call:

jobs:
  build-beta:
    name: Build beta
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          # By default, the checkout action checks out the last merge commit for pull requests.
          # Source: https://docs.github.com/en/actions/writing-workflows/choosing-when-your-workflow-runs/events-that-trigger-workflows#pull_request
          # However, we need the head commit (the latest commit pushed to the source branch)
          # because in the workflow, we would like to parse the latest commit message.
          # Specifying `ref` ensures that the head commit is checked out directly.
          # For a `pull_request` event, the head commit hash is `github.event.pull_request.head.sha`.
          # For a `push` event, the head commit hash is `github.sha`.
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}

      - name: Needs beta build
        # For a `pull_request` event, the branch is `github.head_ref``.
        # For a `push` event, the branch is `github.ref_name`.
        if: ${{ (github.head_ref || github.ref_name) != 'master' }}
        id: needs-beta-build
        env:
          BRANCH: ${{ github.head_ref || github.ref_name }}
        run: |
          version="${BRANCH/Version-v/}"
          commit_message=$(git show -s --format=%s HEAD)
          beta_version_regex="Version v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+-beta\.[0-9]+"

          if [[ "$commit_message" =~ $beta_version_regex ]]; then
              printf '%s\n' "Creating a build for $version with $commit_message"
              echo "NEEDS_BETA_BUILD=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
              printf '%s\n' 'Commit message does not match commit message for beta pattern; skipping beta build'
              echo "NEEDS_BETA_BUILD=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

      - name: Setup environment
        if: ${{ steps.needs-beta-build.outputs.NEEDS_BETA_BUILD == 'true' }}
        uses: metamask/github-tools/.github/actions/setup-environment@main

      - name: Run beta build
        if: ${{ steps.needs-beta-build.outputs.NEEDS_BETA_BUILD == 'true' }}
        env:
          INFURA_PROJECT_ID: 00000000000
          INFURA_BETA_PROJECT_ID: 00000000000
          SEGMENT_BETA_WRITE_KEY: 00000000000
          ENABLE_MV3: true
        run: |
          yarn build --build-type beta --platform='chrome' dist
          yarn build --build-type beta --platform='chrome' prod

      - name: Validate source maps
        if: ${{ steps.needs-beta-build.outputs.NEEDS_BETA_BUILD == 'true' }}
        run: yarn validate-source-maps

      - name: Upload 'dist-beta' to S3
        if: ${{ steps.needs-beta-build.outputs.NEEDS_BETA_BUILD == 'true' }}
        uses: metamask/github-tools/.github/actions/upload-s3@1233659b3850eb84824d7375e2e0c58eb237701d
        with:

          s3-bucket: ${{ vars.AWS_S3_BUCKET }}/${{ github.event.repository.name }}/${{ github.run_id }}/dist-beta
          path: dist

      - name: Upload 'builds-beta' to S3

        uses: metamask/github-tools/.github/actions/upload-s3@1233659b3850eb84824d7375e2e0c58eb237701d

      - name: test:integration:coverage

        with:
          name: coverage-integration
          path: coverage/integration/coverage-integration.json

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs:

To set up the MetaMask project (`metamask-extension`) and run its test suite in a fresh Docker container, follow these guidelines. 

**Dockerfile Creation:**
1. **Base Image**: Start with an appropriate base image for the project. If the project uses Node.js, consider using a Node.js image, e.g., `FROM node:20-slim`.
   
2. **Install Git**: Always ensure that Git is installed as a separate line in your Dockerfile to prevent potential failures during the project cloning phase. For example:
   ```dockerfile
   RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y git
   ```

3. **Install Dependencies**: Install other system dependencies necessary for building the project. This could include tools like `build-essential` for compiling native modules. Make sure to separate installing Git from other packages:
   ```dockerfile
   RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y build-essential
   ```

4. **Set Working Directory**: Set the working directory to where the project will be located:
   ```dockerfile
   WORKDIR /app
   ```

5. **Clone the Repository**: Clone the MetaMask repository. Use the command below, replacing `project_git_url` with the actual repository URL:
   ```dockerfile
   RUN git clone https://github.com/MetaMask/metamask-extension.git
   ```

6. **Set Project Directory**: Navigate to the project directory:
   ```dockerfile
   WORKDIR /app/metamask-extension
   ```

7. **Install Node.js Dependencies**: Assuming the project uses `yarn`, install the dependencies:
   ```dockerfile
   RUN yarn install
   ```

8. **Build the Project**: Build the project to create the necessary output files:
   ```dockerfile
   RUN yarn build
   ```

9. **Prepare for Testing**: You may need to run additional setup or migration scripts if specified in the project documentation, but these would typically be done inside the container after it is started.

10. **Run Tests**: To run the test suite, you can specify a command in the CMD section. For instance, if you want to run unit tests, use:
    ```dockerfile
    CMD ["yarn", "test"]
    ```

**Important Notes:**
- Do not append `|| exit 0` to commands you execute directly in the Linux terminal. This should only be added to `RUN` instructions within the Dockerfile.
- **No Docker Commands in Terminal**: You are not allowed to use docker commands in the terminal tool, meaning commands like "docker something..." are prohibited.
- **Dockerfile Creation**: There is no need to use docker commands directly; just create a Dockerfile and the process of building the image and starting the container will be triggered automatically.

**Caution**: The information provided might not cover all possible scenarios, as there may be missing dependencies, incorrect package versions, or specific configurations required for the MetaMask project that are not documented. Always refer to the official project documentation on GitHub or other reliable sources to verify correctness and obtain additional details.

```dockerfile
FROM node:20-slim

# Install git
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y git

# Install other required packages
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y build-essential

# Set the working directory
WORKDIR /app

# Clone the repository
RUN git clone https://github.com/MetaMask/metamask-extension.git

# Change to project directory
WORKDIR /app/metamask-extension

# Install dependencies
RUN yarn install

# Build the project
RUN yarn build

# Run tests
CMD ["yarn", "test"]

name: Build beta

on:
  workflow_call:

jobs:
  build-beta:
    name: Build beta
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          # By default, the checkout action checks out the last merge commit for pull requests.
          # Source: https://docs.github.com/en/actions/writing-workflows/choosing-when-your-workflow-runs/events-that-trigger-workflows#pull_request
          # However, we need the head commit (the latest commit pushed to the source branch)
          # because in the workflow, we would like to parse the latest commit message.
          # Specifying `ref` ensures that the head commit is checked out directly.
          # For a `pull_request` event, the head commit hash is `github.event.pull_request.head.sha`.
          # For a `push` event, the head commit hash is `github.sha`.
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}

      - name: Needs beta build
        # For a `pull_request` event, the branch is `github.head_ref``.
        # For a `push` event, the branch is `github.ref_name`.
        if: ${{ (github.head_ref || github.ref_name) != 'master' }}
        id: needs-beta-build
        env:
          BRANCH: ${{ github.head_ref || github.ref_name }}
        run: |
          version="${BRANCH/Version-v/}"
          commit_message=$(git show -s --format=%s HEAD)
          beta_version_regex="Version v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+-beta\.[0-9]+"

          if [[ "$commit_message" =~ $beta_version_regex ]]; then
              printf '%s\n' "Creating a build for $version with $commit_message"
              echo "NEEDS_BETA_BUILD=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
              printf '%s\n' 'Commit message does not match commit message for beta pattern; skipping beta build'
              echo "NEEDS_BETA_BUILD=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

      - name: Setup environment
        if: ${{ steps.needs-beta-build.outputs.NEEDS_BETA_BUILD == 'true' }}
        uses: metamask/github-tools/.github/actions/setup-environment@main

      - name: Run beta build
        if: ${{ steps.needs-beta-build.outputs.NEEDS_BETA_BUILD == 'true' }}
        env:
          INFURA_PROJECT_ID: 00000000000
          INFURA_BETA_PROJECT_ID: 00000000000
          SEGMENT_BETA_WRITE_KEY: 00000000000
          ENABLE_MV3: true
        run: |
          yarn build --build-type beta --platform='chrome' dist
          yarn build --build-type beta --platform='chrome' prod

      - name: Validate source maps
        if: ${{ steps.needs-beta-build.outputs.NEEDS_BETA_BUILD == 'true' }}
        run: yarn validate-source-maps

      - name: Upload 'dist-beta' to S3
        if: ${{ steps.needs-beta-build.outputs.NEEDS_BETA_BUILD == 'true' }}
        uses: metamask/github-tools/.github/actions/upload-s3@1233659b3850eb84824d7375e2e0c58eb237701d
        with:

          role-to-assume: ${{ vars.AWS_IAM_ROLE }}
          s3-bucket: ${{ vars.AWS_S3_BUCKET }}/${{ github.event.repository.name }}/${{ github.run_id }}/dist-beta
          path: dist

      - name: Upload 'builds-beta' to S3
        if: ${{ steps.needs-beta-build.outputs.NEEDS_BETA_BUILD == 'true' }}
        uses: metamask/github-tools/.github/actions/upload-s3@1233659b3850eb84824d7375e2e0c58eb237701d

        with:

    steps:

        run: yarn test:integration:coverage

      - name: Rename coverage

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: coverage-integration
          path: coverage/integration/coverage-integration.json

  report-coverage:
    name: Report coverage
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs:
      - test-unit
      - test-webpack
      - test-integration
    outputs:

1. **Base Image**: Start with an appropriate base image for the project. If the project uses Node.js, consider using a Node.js image, e.g., `FROM node:20-slim`.
   
2. **Install Git**: Always ensure that Git is installed as a separate line in your Dockerfile to prevent potential failures during the project cloning phase. For example:
   ```dockerfile
   RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y git
   ```

3. **Install Dependencies**: Install other system dependencies necessary for building the project. This could include tools like `build-essential` for compiling native modules. Make sure to separate installing Git from other packages:
   ```dockerfile
   RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y build-essential
   ```

4. **Set Working Directory**: Set the working directory to where the project will be located:
   ```dockerfile
   WORKDIR /app
   ```

5. **Clone the Repository**: Clone the MetaMask repository. Use the command below, replacing `project_git_url` with the actual repository URL:
   ```dockerfile
   RUN git clone https://github.com/MetaMask/metamask-extension.git
   ```

6. **Set Project Directory**: Navigate to the project directory:
   ```dockerfile
   WORKDIR /app/metamask-extension
   ```

7. **Install Node.js Dependencies**: Assuming the project uses `yarn`, install the dependencies:
   ```dockerfile
   RUN yarn install
   ```

8. **Build the Project**: Build the project to create the necessary output files:
   ```dockerfile
   RUN yarn build
   ```

9. **Prepare for Testing**: You may need to run additional setup or migration scripts if specified in the project documentation, but these would typically be done inside the container after it is started.

10. **Run Tests**: To run the test suite, you can specify a command in the CMD section. For instance, if you want to run unit tests, use:
    ```dockerfile
    CMD ["yarn", "test"]
    ```

name: Build beta

on:
  workflow_call:

jobs:
  build-beta:
    name: Build beta
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          # By default, the checkout action checks out the last merge commit for pull requests.
          # Source: https://docs.github.com/en/actions/writing-workflows/choosing-when-your-workflow-runs/events-that-trigger-workflows#pull_request
          # However, we need the head commit (the latest commit pushed to the source branch)
          # because in the workflow, we would like to parse the latest commit message.
          # Specifying `ref` ensures that the head commit is checked out directly.
          # For a `pull_request` event, the head commit hash is `github.event.pull_request.head.sha`.
          # For a `push` event, the head commit hash is `github.sha`.
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}

      - name: Needs beta build
        # For a `pull_request` event, the branch is `github.head_ref``.
        # For a `push` event, the branch is `github.ref_name`.
        if: ${{ (github.head_ref || github.ref_name) != 'master' }}
        id: needs-beta-build
        env:
          BRANCH: ${{ github.head_ref || github.ref_name }}
        run: |
          version="${BRANCH/Version-v/}"
          commit_message=$(git show -s --format=%s HEAD)
          beta_version_regex="Version v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+-beta\.[0-9]+"

          if [[ "$commit_message" =~ $beta_version_regex ]]; then
              printf '%s\n' "Creating a build for $version with $commit_message"
              echo "NEEDS_BETA_BUILD=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
              printf '%s\n' 'Commit message does not match commit message for beta pattern; skipping beta build'
              echo "NEEDS_BETA_BUILD=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

      - name: Setup environment
        if: ${{ steps.needs-beta-build.outputs.NEEDS_BETA_BUILD == 'true' }}
        uses: metamask/github-tools/.github/actions/setup-environment@main

      - name: Run beta build
        if: ${{ steps.needs-beta-build.outputs.NEEDS_BETA_BUILD == 'true' }}
        env:
          INFURA_PROJECT_ID: 00000000000
          INFURA_BETA_PROJECT_ID: 00000000000
          SEGMENT_BETA_WRITE_KEY: 00000000000
          ENABLE_MV3: true
        run: |
          yarn build --build-type beta --platform='chrome' dist
          yarn build --build-type beta --platform='chrome' prod

      - name: Validate source maps
        if: ${{ steps.needs-beta-build.outputs.NEEDS_BETA_BUILD == 'true' }}
        run: yarn validate-source-maps

      - name: Upload 'dist-beta' to S3
        if: ${{ steps.needs-beta-build.outputs.NEEDS_BETA_BUILD == 'true' }}
        uses: metamask/github-tools/.github/actions/upload-s3@1233659b3850eb84824d7375e2e0c58eb237701d

          s3-bucket: ${{ vars.AWS_S3_BUCKET }}/${{ github.event.repository.name }}/${{ github.run_id }}/dist-beta
          path: dist

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:

          path: coverage/webpack/coverage-webpack.json

    name: Integration tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup environment
        uses: metamask/github-tools/.github/actions/setup-environment@main

      - name: test:integration:coverage
        run: yarn test:integration:coverage

      - name: Rename coverage
        run: mv coverage/integration/coverage-final.json coverage/integration/coverage-integration.json

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: coverage-integration
          path: coverage/integration/coverage-integration.json

  report-coverage:
    name: Report coverage
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs:
      - test-unit
      - test-webpack
      - test-integration
    outputs:
      current-coverage: ${{ steps.get-current-coverage.outputs.CURRENT_COVERAGE }}

name: Build beta

on:
  workflow_call:

jobs:
  build-beta:
    name: Build beta
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          # By default, the checkout action checks out the last merge commit for pull requests.
          # Source: https://docs.github.com/en/actions/writing-workflows/choosing-when-your-workflow-runs/events-that-trigger-workflows#pull_request
          # However, we need the head commit (the latest commit pushed to the source branch)
          # because in the workflow, we would like to parse the latest commit message.
          # Specifying `ref` ensures that the head commit is checked out directly.
          # For a `pull_request` event, the head commit hash is `github.event.pull_request.head.sha`.
          # For a `push` event, the head commit hash is `github.sha`.
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}

      - name: Needs beta build
        # For a `pull_request` event, the branch is `github.head_ref``.
        # For a `push` event, the branch is `github.ref_name`.
        if: ${{ (github.head_ref || github.ref_name) != 'master' }}
        id: needs-beta-build
        env:
          BRANCH: ${{ github.head_ref || github.ref_name }}
        run: |
          version="${BRANCH/Version-v/}"
          commit_message=$(git show -s --format=%s HEAD)
          beta_version_regex="Version v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+-beta\.[0-9]+"

          if [[ "$commit_message" =~ $beta_version_regex ]]; then
              printf '%s\n' "Creating a build for $version with $commit_message"
              echo "NEEDS_BETA_BUILD=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
              printf '%s\n' 'Commit message does not match commit message for beta pattern; skipping beta build'
              echo "NEEDS_BETA_BUILD=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

      - name: Setup environment
        if: ${{ steps.needs-beta-build.outputs.NEEDS_BETA_BUILD == 'true' }}
        uses: metamask/github-tools/.github/actions/setup-environment@main

      - name: Run beta build
        if: ${{ steps.needs-beta-build.outputs.NEEDS_BETA_BUILD == 'true' }}
        env:
          INFURA_PROJECT_ID: 00000000000
          INFURA_BETA_PROJECT_ID: 00000000000
          SEGMENT_BETA_WRITE_KEY: 00000000000
          ENABLE_MV3: true
        run: |
          yarn build --build-type beta --platform='chrome' dist
          yarn build --build-type beta --platform='chrome' prod

      - name: Validate source maps
        if: ${{ steps.needs-beta-build.outputs.NEEDS_BETA_BUILD == 'true' }}
        run: yarn validate-source-maps

      - name: Upload 'dist-beta' to S3

        uses: metamask/github-tools/.github/actions/upload-s3@1233659b3850eb84824d7375e2e0c58eb237701d

          path: dist

        with:

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs:

name: Build beta

on:
  workflow_call:

jobs:
  build-beta:
    name: Build beta
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          # By default, the checkout action checks out the last merge commit for pull requests.
          # Source: https://docs.github.com/en/actions/writing-workflows/choosing-when-your-workflow-runs/events-that-trigger-workflows#pull_request
          # However, we need the head commit (the latest commit pushed to the source branch)
          # because in the workflow, we would like to parse the latest commit message.
          # Specifying `ref` ensures that the head commit is checked out directly.
          # For a `pull_request` event, the head commit hash is `github.event.pull_request.head.sha`.
          # For a `push` event, the head commit hash is `github.sha`.
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}

      - name: Needs beta build
        # For a `pull_request` event, the branch is `github.head_ref``.
        # For a `push` event, the branch is `github.ref_name`.
        if: ${{ (github.head_ref || github.ref_name) != 'master' }}
        id: needs-beta-build
        env:
          BRANCH: ${{ github.head_ref || github.ref_name }}
        run: |
          version="${BRANCH/Version-v/}"
          commit_message=$(git show -s --format=%s HEAD)
          beta_version_regex="Version v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+-beta\.[0-9]+"

          if [[ "$commit_message" =~ $beta_version_regex ]]; then
              printf '%s\n' "Creating a build for $version with $commit_message"
              echo "NEEDS_BETA_BUILD=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
              printf '%s\n' 'Commit message does not match commit message for beta pattern; skipping beta build'
              echo "NEEDS_BETA_BUILD=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

      - name: Setup environment
        if: ${{ steps.needs-beta-build.outputs.NEEDS_BETA_BUILD == 'true' }}
        uses: metamask/github-tools/.github/actions/setup-environment@main

      - name: Run beta build
        if: ${{ steps.needs-beta-build.outputs.NEEDS_BETA_BUILD == 'true' }}
        env:
          INFURA_PROJECT_ID: 00000000000
          INFURA_BETA_PROJECT_ID: 00000000000
          SEGMENT_BETA_WRITE_KEY: 00000000000
          ENABLE_MV3: true
        run: |
          yarn build --build-type beta --platform='chrome' dist
          yarn build --build-type beta --platform='chrome' prod

      - name: Validate source maps
        if: ${{ steps.needs-beta-build.outputs.NEEDS_BETA_BUILD == 'true' }}
        run: yarn validate-source-maps

      - name: Upload 'dist-beta' to S3
        if: ${{ steps.needs-beta-build.outputs.NEEDS_BETA_BUILD == 'true' }}
        uses: metamask/github-tools/.github/actions/upload-s3@1233659b3850eb84824d7375e2e0c58eb237701d
        with:
          aws-region: ${{ vars.AWS_REGION }}
          role-to-assume: ${{ vars.AWS_IAM_ROLE }}
          s3-bucket: ${{ vars.AWS_S3_BUCKET }}/${{ github.event.repository.name }}/${{ github.run_id }}/dist-beta
          path: dist

      - name: Upload 'builds-beta' to S3
        if: ${{ steps.needs-beta-build.outputs.NEEDS_BETA_BUILD == 'true' }}
        uses: metamask/github-tools/.github/actions/upload-s3@1233659b3850eb84824d7375e2e0c58eb237701d
        with:

          s3-bucket: ${{ vars.AWS_S3_BUCKET }}/${{ github.event.repository.name }}/${{ github.run_id }}/builds-beta
          path: builds

   ```

3. **Install Dependencies**: Install other system dependencies necessary for building the project. This could include tools like `build-essential` for compiling native modules. Make sure to separate installing Git from other packages:

name: Build beta

on:
  workflow_call:

jobs:
  build-beta:
    name: Build beta
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          # By default, the checkout action checks out the last merge commit for pull requests.
          # Source: https://docs.github.com/en/actions/writing-workflows/choosing-when-your-workflow-runs/events-that-trigger-workflows#pull_request
          # However, we need the head commit (the latest commit pushed to the source branch)
          # because in the workflow, we would like to parse the latest commit message.
          # Specifying `ref` ensures that the head commit is checked out directly.
          # For a `pull_request` event, the head commit hash is `github.event.pull_request.head.sha`.
          # For a `push` event, the head commit hash is `github.sha`.
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}

      - name: Needs beta build
        # For a `pull_request` event, the branch is `github.head_ref``.
        # For a `push` event, the branch is `github.ref_name`.
        if: ${{ (github.head_ref || github.ref_name) != 'master' }}
        id: needs-beta-build
        env:
          BRANCH: ${{ github.head_ref || github.ref_name }}
        run: |
          version="${BRANCH/Version-v/}"
          commit_message=$(git show -s --format=%s HEAD)
          beta_version_regex="Version v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+-beta\.[0-9]+"

          if [[ "$commit_message" =~ $beta_version_regex ]]; then
              printf '%s\n' "Creating a build for $version with $commit_message"
              echo "NEEDS_BETA_BUILD=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
              printf '%s\n' 'Commit message does not match commit message for beta pattern; skipping beta build'
              echo "NEEDS_BETA_BUILD=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

      - name: Setup environment
        if: ${{ steps.needs-beta-build.outputs.NEEDS_BETA_BUILD == 'true' }}
        uses: metamask/github-tools/.github/actions/setup-environment@main

      - name: Run beta build
        if: ${{ steps.needs-beta-build.outputs.NEEDS_BETA_BUILD == 'true' }}
        env:
          INFURA_PROJECT_ID: 00000000000
          INFURA_BETA_PROJECT_ID: 00000000000
          SEGMENT_BETA_WRITE_KEY: 00000000000
          ENABLE_MV3: true
        run: |
          yarn build --build-type beta --platform='chrome' dist
          yarn build --build-type beta --platform='chrome' prod

      - name: Validate source maps
        if: ${{ steps.needs-beta-build.outputs.NEEDS_BETA_BUILD == 'true' }}
        run: yarn validate-source-maps

      - name: Upload 'dist-beta' to S3
        if: ${{ steps.needs-beta-build.outputs.NEEDS_BETA_BUILD == 'true' }}
        uses: metamask/github-tools/.github/actions/upload-s3@1233659b3850eb84824d7375e2e0c58eb237701d
        with:
          aws-region: ${{ vars.AWS_REGION }}
          role-to-assume: ${{ vars.AWS_IAM_ROLE }}
          s3-bucket: ${{ vars.AWS_S3_BUCKET }}/${{ github.event.repository.name }}/${{ github.run_id }}/dist-beta
          path: dist

      - name: Upload 'builds-beta' to S3
        if: ${{ steps.needs-beta-build.outputs.NEEDS_BETA_BUILD == 'true' }}
        uses: metamask/github-tools/.github/actions/upload-s3@1233659b3850eb84824d7375e2e0c58eb237701d

          s3-bucket: ${{ vars.AWS_S3_BUCKET }}/${{ github.event.repository.name }}/${{ github.run_id }}/builds-beta
          path: builds

   ```

name: Build beta

on:
  workflow_call:

jobs:
  build-beta:
    name: Build beta
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          # By default, the checkout action checks out the last merge commit for pull requests.
          # Source: https://docs.github.com/en/actions/writing-workflows/choosing-when-your-workflow-runs/events-that-trigger-workflows#pull_request
          # However, we need the head commit (the latest commit pushed to the source branch)
          # because in the workflow, we would like to parse the latest commit message.
          # Specifying `ref` ensures that the head commit is checked out directly.
          # For a `pull_request` event, the head commit hash is `github.event.pull_request.head.sha`.
          # For a `push` event, the head commit hash is `github.sha`.
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}

      - name: Needs beta build
        # For a `pull_request` event, the branch is `github.head_ref``.
        # For a `push` event, the branch is `github.ref_name`.
        if: ${{ (github.head_ref || github.ref_name) != 'master' }}
        id: needs-beta-build
        env:
          BRANCH: ${{ github.head_ref || github.ref_name }}
        run: |
          version="${BRANCH/Version-v/}"
          commit_message=$(git show -s --format=%s HEAD)
          beta_version_regex="Version v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+-beta\.[0-9]+"

          if [[ "$commit_message" =~ $beta_version_regex ]]; then
              printf '%s\n' "Creating a build for $version with $commit_message"
              echo "NEEDS_BETA_BUILD=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
              printf '%s\n' 'Commit message does not match commit message for beta pattern; skipping beta build'
              echo "NEEDS_BETA_BUILD=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

      - name: Setup environment
        if: ${{ steps.needs-beta-build.outputs.NEEDS_BETA_BUILD == 'true' }}
        uses: metamask/github-tools/.github/actions/setup-environment@main

      - name: Run beta build
        if: ${{ steps.needs-beta-build.outputs.NEEDS_BETA_BUILD == 'true' }}
        env:
          INFURA_PROJECT_ID: 00000000000
          INFURA_BETA_PROJECT_ID: 00000000000
          SEGMENT_BETA_WRITE_KEY: 00000000000
          ENABLE_MV3: true
        run: |
          yarn build --build-type beta --platform='chrome' dist
          yarn build --build-type beta --platform='chrome' prod

      - name: Validate source maps
        if: ${{ steps.needs-beta-build.outputs.NEEDS_BETA_BUILD == 'true' }}
        run: yarn validate-source-maps

      - name: Upload 'dist-beta' to S3
        if: ${{ steps.needs-beta-build.outputs.NEEDS_BETA_BUILD == 'true' }}
        uses: metamask/github-tools/.github/actions/upload-s3@1233659b3850eb84824d7375e2e0c58eb237701d
        with:
          aws-region: ${{ vars.AWS_REGION }}
          role-to-assume: ${{ vars.AWS_IAM_ROLE }}
          s3-bucket: ${{ vars.AWS_S3_BUCKET }}/${{ github.event.repository.name }}/${{ github.run_id }}/dist-beta
          path: dist

      - name: Upload 'builds-beta' to S3
        if: ${{ steps.needs-beta-build.outputs.NEEDS_BETA_BUILD == 'true' }}
        uses: metamask/github-tools/.github/actions/upload-s3@1233659b3850eb84824d7375e2e0c58eb237701d
        with:

          s3-bucket: ${{ vars.AWS_S3_BUCKET }}/${{ github.event.repository.name }}/${{ github.run_id }}/builds-beta
          path: builds

  test-integration:
    name: Integration tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup environment
        uses: metamask/github-tools/.github/actions/setup-environment@main

      - name: test:integration:coverage
        run: yarn test:integration:coverage

      - name: Rename coverage
        run: mv coverage/integration/coverage-final.json coverage/integration/coverage-integration.json

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: coverage-integration
          path: coverage/integration/coverage-integration.json

  report-coverage:
    name: Report coverage
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs:
      - test-unit
      - test-webpack
      - test-integration
    outputs:
      current-coverage: ${{ steps.get-current-coverage.outputs.CURRENT_COVERAGE }}
      stored-coverage: ${{ steps.get-stored-coverage.outputs.STORED_COVERAGE }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup environment
        uses: metamask/github-tools/.github/actions/setup-environment@main

      - name: Download artifacts
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          path: coverage
          merge-multiple: true

      - name: Merge coverage reports
        run: yarn nyc merge coverage .nyc_output/coverage-final.json && yarn nyc report --reporter lcov

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: lcov.info
          path: coverage/lcov.info

      - name: Get current coverage
        id: get-current-coverage
        run: |
          current_coverage=$(yarn nyc report --reporter=text-summary | grep 'Lines' | awk '{gsub(/%/, ""); print int($3)}')
          echo "The current coverage is $current_coverage%."
          echo 'CURRENT_COVERAGE='"$current_coverage" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Get stored coverage
        id: get-stored-coverage
        run: |
          stored_coverage=$(jq ".coverage" coverage.json)
          echo "The stored coverage is $stored_coverage%."
          echo 'STORED_COVERAGE='"$stored_coverage" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Validate test coverage
        env:
          CURRENT_COVERAGE: ${{ steps.get-current-coverage.outputs.CURRENT_COVERAGE }}
          STORED_COVERAGE: ${{ steps.get-stored-coverage.outputs.STORED_COVERAGE }}
        run: |
          if (( $(echo "$CURRENT_COVERAGE < $STORED_COVERAGE" | bc -l) )); then
            echo "::error::Quality gate failed for test coverage. Current coverage is $CURRENT_COVERAGE%, please increase coverage to at least $STORED_COVERAGE%."
            exit 1
          else
            echo "The current coverage is $CURRENT_COVERAGE%, stored coverage is $STORED_COVERAGE%. Quality gate passed."
          fi
